OriginalEnglish: I can't just stand by and do nothing while Dunisia and Harba tear each other apart<FG>
Me neither<FG> I'm coming too<FG>
...Well, Your Majesty<FH> Do we have your blessing<FH>
Very well, Lady Desdemona.
Your two young friends may accompany you on your mission.
My thanks.
Your Majesty, I solemnly swear we'll do everything in our power to<MV>
Allllllright<FG> Now we're talking<FG> Leave it to us, big man<FG>
We'll get the High King to help even if I have to twist his arm off<FG>
Shut up<FG>
I, too, shall accompany these brave warriors, Your Majesty<FG>
Stop it<FG>
Will you two be serious for just one second<FG>
Go safely, now.
Yes, Your Majesty.
This is the final stretch of the road to Accordia.
Not far now.
I can't wait<FG> I've always wanted to visit<FG>
Pinnacle of Peace, here we come<FG>
So that's the famous tower<FH> It's tall, alright.
It'll probably take days to get all the way to the top.
Heh. Seriously<FH> You're planning on climbing it<FH>
Yeeeeeeah<FG><FG><FG>
What is it<FH>
Something's coming this way.
Through the trees.
Er... Are you alright<FH>
Ehhh<FH>
Weeell, I've not the first clue who youse are, but ye couldn't have come at a better time<FG>
Ach, I'm in a quare auld pickle, so I am<FG>
You're in a what now<FH>
I see... Seems you've picked up some unwanted admirers.
Well, ah... Seems I have, right enough.
Well<FG> Only one thing for it, then<MV>let's give 'em the old brush-off<FG>
Yeeeah<FG> And don't come back<FG>
That looks like the last of them.
Sure, an' I've not the words to thank youse all<FG>
If I'd been on me lonesome, I'd've been banjaxed for certain<FG>
So tell us, Pickles<MV>who are you, anyway<FH>
And what's all that rubbish on your back<FH>
Begorra, forgive me, mannerless culchie that I am<FG>
Torneko Taloon's the name<FG>
Humble weapon merchant of Endor town<FG>
‘Endor’...<FH>
That's not a place I've been to<MV>or heard of.
I've never heard of it either.
So ye've never heard of it at all, at all<FH>
I'm startin' to think my little hunch might be right...
I've only gone and wandered into another blessed world<FG>
Too busy seekin' out that legendary weapon to notice, so I was<FG>
When you say ‘another world’, you mean this one, right<FH>
So the place that you're from...
is somewhere completely different, is it<FH>
Sure, 'tis the only explanation I can think of.
I love a good auld adventure, see, and there's not a patch o' grass in the whole wide world I've not trod me foot upon.
And yet, here I find meself in fields of an altogether unfamiliar green<FG>
I was rootin' around fer a way back home in yonder woods
when yer lads there took a shine to me, the little devils.
Simple as that, eh<FH>
Aye.
You ran into them, and they ran after you.
Wait a minute, though<MV>
if you don't know how you ended up here in the first place...
you probably don't know how to get back to your own world either, right<FH>
No...
It's...Torneko, correct<FH>
If I might make a suggestion<FI> why not come with us to Accordia and see the High King<FH>
His Radiance is one of the wisest men alive.
Who knows<MV>he may even be able to tell you how to get back to your world.
And besides, Accordia is where all the best and rarest goods in the world change hands.
You might even find your legendary weapon there.
Yeah, she's right<FG> You're coming with us, Pickles<FG>
Indeed<FG> Journey with us, good sir<FG>
You two<FG>
His name is not Pickles<MV>it's Torneko<FG>
And you can't just bully him into coming<MV>he can decide for himself<FG>
Seriously, though<MV>you should come with us.
We can't just leave you stranded here.
How's that fer luck, eh<FH>
Landin' square in the lap o' the strongest, noblest, kindest band o' heroes in this whole new world<FG>
How could I possibly find it in me heart to refuse<FH>
I'll gladly tag along with youse<FG>
Your Radiance.
It is I, Desdemona.
I returned from Harba as quickly as I was able.
I bring grave tidings. If you will permit me to make a full report...
Mmm... You serve me as impeccably as ever.
Come, lift up your face, child.
Sire.
It would appear that you have not returned alone.
Indeed, Sire. These two brave young warriors aided me greatly in my mission.
I am glad you found support in some quarters.
And yet...
It is plain that the Dunisians could not be persuaded from the path of aggression.
Alas not.
With the help of my companions here, I was able to turn back their advance at the inner gate...
But the Dunisians seem determined to press their advantage.
It is only a matter of time, I fear...before they renew their assault.
Your Radiance.
The King of Harba, distraught at what has befallen his people, has expressed a strong desire to negotiate a peace.
Accordingly, he asks that I relay to you his dearest wish.
He humbly begs you to intervene, as Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms, and seek a resolution without further bloodshed.
And what of our young Harban friends<FH>
What would they have me do<FH>
Do you, like your ever-noble king, wish to make peace with Dunisia<FH>
Or do you perhaps seek vengeance instead<FH>
Answer truthfully, now.
We want peace<FG> We want the war with Dunisia to end<FG>
But we...
We're not Harbans<FG> We're Dunisians, born and raised<FG>
But, well, the Harbans have been good to us<MV>to me.
So we don't want anyone hurting anyone else.
Not Harbans, not Dunisians<MV>no one<FG> So<MV>
So we want the war to end, and we'd do anything to stop it<FG>
Children of Dunisia standing up for their Harban cousins<FH>
How chivalrous<FG> I do love a spot of selfless heroism<FG>
The events of these past days have come perilously close to upsetting the balance of our world. But fear not.
I hereby swear, as Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms,
to do all in my power to prevent that direst of prophecies from coming true.
However... Before we set about bringing this war to an end, we will first need to understand its causes.
Causes<FH>
You wish me to uncover the Dunisians' motive...
their reason for attacking<FH>
I do.
I will leave for Dunisia right away, and believe me, Sire<MV>the truth behind their war-making will not elude me.
I'm coming with you<FG>
Me too<FG>
If anyone can talk some sense into Cesar, it's us<FG>
Yes...
Your fates and those of the warring kingdoms are already intertwined.
I suspect that you may indeed be of use.
You have my blessing.
Yessssss<FG> We won't let you down, Your Radiance<FG>
Just you wait<MV>you're gonna be SO glad you sent us<FG>
We'll peer into Cesar's earhole and find out what's going on in his thick head<FG>
Honestly<FG>
That's the most important man in the world<FG>
When you speak to him, show some flipping respect<FG>
Very well. Set forth without delay<FG>
The seeds of war shall not be suffered to take root in our world once more<FG>
Hey<FG> Look, that's...
There's no mistaking it...that's the Dunisian standard...
They're headed for Harba<FG>
Ah, ah now<FG> Look there<FG>
The poor chisellers are in trouble<FG>
Maribel<FG> Are you okay<FH>
You can see perfectly well that I'm fine<FG>
Just what do these idiots want with us, anyway<FH>
They've certainly got a funny way of making friends<FG>
What are we going to do<FG><FH>
I don't know...
Maybe...find some food<FH>
Grrr<FG>
Will you forget about your stupid stomach for one minute<FG>
What are they doing<FG><FH> That's half the Dunisian army down there<FG>
Why would two little kids try to take them on<FG><FH>
Never mind the whos and whys<FG>
They're about to get made into monster food<FG>
Ooooooi<FG> Hold on, we're coming to get you<FG>
CHAAAAAARGE<FG>
B<MV> Hold on<FG>
Ugh<FG>
You can't just go charging in alone<MV>that's basic tactics<FG>
You're right, of course. We'd better get after them.
If my suspicions are correct, this is only the Dunisian vanguard.
We need to get those two out of there before the rest of the army arrives.
Good point.
That's that lot sent packing<FG>
Honestly<FG> Some people just don't know when to give up<FG>
What is it now<FH>
But it can't be<FG> What are the Harbans doing here<FH>
YOUR MAJESTY<FG>
Whoa<FG>
Well, well<FG> Look who it is<FG>
Your Majesty. Might I ask what you're doing here<FH>
You stand on Dunisian soil. And with an army, no less.
I regret that my hand was forced.
We received word that they were preparing to mount another assault.
As King of Harba, I cannot stand idly by while my lands and my subjects are attacked.
That is why I and all my men have crossed the border.
We will drive back the tide of marauders ere it reaches us.
If they mean to take my head, let them try.
But let it be on the battlefield and not in my people's home.
But where will it all end<FH> What if Dunisia and Harba keep on fighting till<MV>
Hey<FG>
Can one of you lot PLEASE tell me what you're all blathering on about<FG><FH>
Where exactly are we<FH> And what exactly is going on<FH>
Oh, I'm sorry, sweetie. Let's see...
‘Sweetie’<FG><FH> Do you mind not talking to me like a three-year-old<FH>
I DO have a name, you know<FG>
I am Maribel<FG>
And this flea-ridden little midget is Ruff<FG>
Well, well. Here come the cavalry...
Cesar<FG>
Looks like he's leading the charge. Just like back in Harba...
I will ride out and meet with him.
We will discuss this sorry matter face-to-face.
War must be avoided. A peaceful resolution must be<MV>
It looks as if parley won't be an option.
This will be settled violently or not at all.
Then let's settle it as quickly as we can<FG>
Ugh, really<FG><FH>
We don't even know these people, let alone what they're dragging us into<FG>
Then again...they did get us out of a tight spot back there...
Fine<FG> We'll help them out, but just this once, okay<FH>
We'd better do our bit as well.
Time to stop Cesar in his tracks and finally put an end to this<FG>
Let's go<FG>
Gotcha<FG>
Will you stop charging off on your own like that<FG>
Cesar<FG>
Well, look who it is.
What's going on, Cesar<FH>
Why are you attacking the Harbans<FH>
It's been a while, eh, Your Highness<FH>
Seriously<MV>did no one ever tell you about barging into places uninvited<FH>
Hm. What business is it of yours<FH>
Four more years of training, and still you lack the discipline to stay out of others' affairs.
I'd hoped you might have learned by now when your presence was neither valued nor wanted.
Alas, you are the same thoughtless child as ever.
Yeah<FH> And if I'm thoughtless, then what are you<FH>
Or have you forgotten all the stupid things I've seen you do, Prince Pout-a-Lot<FG><FH>
Hm. How terribly sophisticated you've become. Why<MV>
Stop it<FG> Both of you<FG>
Is this really the time or the place for your bickering<FG><FH>
In case you've forgotten, we came here to try and talk Cesar round<FG>
Talk me round<FH>
Am I to take this to mean...you have turned your coats, and sided with the Harbans<FH>
You will regret that.
Justice will be done.
And those who betray our realm...will suffer the judgement of steel<FG>
Cesar...
Your Highness<FG> Please, you have to listen to reason<FG>
Your friend is in no mood to listen.
We have no choice. And we'll be needing your help if this is going to end well.
Same old Cesar. Once he gets that look in his eye, there's no talking to him.
You're right. We never could get through to him when he was like this.
We sure couldn't. He's clearly got some stupid idea in his head, and we're just going to have to beat it out of him.
Let's go<FG>
So, here he is.
The noble king...who stabbed my father in the back<FG>
That will be quite enough for now, Prince Cesar.
Are we to understand that your attack on Harba was in answer
to some wrong committed against your father, the honoured King of Dunisia<FH> ...Well<FH>
Yes, Your Radiance.
And I make no apology. The Harbans must pay for their crime.
This man, their king...
This faithless worm...
Murdered my father in cold blood<FG>
